items.event: Davis Cup Final 8 QF: Italy v Korea Rep.
items.line: Italy, the three-time defending champions, open in Bologna against Korea, who are playing their first-ever Davis Cup quarterfinal. Italy's listed team is Cobolli, Musetti, Darderi, Vavassori and Bolelli, with no Sinner. In the opening tie, Czechia lead Canada 1-0 after Machac beat Draxl.

items.event: Davis Cup Final 8 QFs: Great Britain v Germany, Austria v Spain
items.line: Great Britain play Germany in their first Davis Cup quarterfinal since 2023, starting Thursday evening Japan time. Austria v Spain starts no earlier than 01:00 JST Fri. The semi-finals are Nov 27-28 and the final is Sun Nov 29 at 23:00 JST.

items.event: BMW Australian PGA Championship (DP World Tour)
items.line: The 2027 Race to Dubai season opens at The Lakes, the first time the event has been played in Sydney in almost 30 years. Three-time champion Cameron Smith is going for a fourth title. Sydney is 2 hours ahead of Japan, so the final round on Sunday falls in the late morning and afternoon JST.
